name: Wordmark-led minimal
summary: The name alone, set or drawn in one weight of a sans, with a single detail that makes it own: a cut stroke, a hidden arrow, a joined pair of letters. No symbol and no frame.

philosophy.core_thesis: The name is the mark: one carefully spaced word, with one detail of its own, is clearer and more durable than any symbol.
design_principles: Use the name in one line, in one weight of a sans or a custom monoline alphabet.
Make exactly one detail own the mark: a removed crossbar, a ligature, a cut stroke or a shape in the counter.
Space by eye: optical tracking of 0–5% for lower case, 5–20% for capitals.
Use one colour for the master; a second colour may mark one part of the word only.
Keep the height of the word at 15–25% of its width, so it fits a header and a narrow sign.
Define clear space as the height of one capital or one x-height on each side.
anti_patterns: A symbol beside the word in the master mark
Outline, shadow or bevel on the letters
A frame or a badge around the word
Distortion of letter widths to fit a box

construction.grid: The baseline, the x-height and the cap height of the alphabet; custom letters share one stroke width and one radius set.
construction.geometry: Monoline strokes; curves either from circles (a geometric sans) or from optical ovals (a grotesque).
construction.stroke_rule: One stroke weight at 12–20% of the cap height; thin joins at 80–90% of it.
construction.symmetry: None; the balance comes from even spacing along the line.
construction.detail_floor: No counter or gap under 10% of the cap height, so the word reads at 16 px high.

form.ornament: None; one typographic detail replaces ornament.
form.letterforms: A geometric or grotesque sans, or a custom monoline alphabet; all capitals or all lower case, rarely mixed.

colour.strategy: One colour, black, or one brand colour on white; a second colour may mark one letter or one word.
colour.reversal_rule: White on a dark ground is a standard version; open the tracking by 2–3% for small white text.

colours.name: Purple
colours.role: first half of a two-colour word

colours.name: Orange
colours.role: second half of a two-colour word

reproduction.clear_space: One cap height on each side, which is about half the mark height.
reproduction.media: Every medium: print, signs, packaging, screen headers and app splash screens.

emotion.target_response: Quiet confidence: the viewer reads the name first and feels a brand that does not need to shout.

avoid_when: The name is long, over 12 letters, and must fit a square icon.
The audience reads a different script than the name.

modifiers.how: Keep the sans and the one colour; add a grid-built symbol to the left at 1–1.5 times the cap height.
Keep the one colour; draw the letters by hand with curved terminals and a shared stroke between two letters.
